title: Calendar and diagonal strategies get max profit, max loss, breakevens and POP (G-13-2, owner question)
reference_behaviour: Mixed-expiry strategies are valued by the model: the at-expiry line becomes a curve, a finite max loss, breakevens and POP are shown, with a note that a calendar can lose more than the max loss shown.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: the engine refuses metrics for mixed expiries; REQ-081 AC-4 and REQ-136 AC-1 show no single maximum on mixed expiries (ADR-143). No requirement gives estimated mixed-expiry metrics.
